record.question: The recipient of the World Health Organization's Tobacco Control Award for the Year 2019 is:
record.explanation: Answer A: Medical & Health Department, Jammu & Kashmir. The WHO’s 2019 World No Tobacco Day award in India was given to the National Tobacco Control Programme in Jammu and Kashmir (the option’s Health Department wording identifies that state recipient). Reference: https://www.who.int/india/news/detail/30-05-2019-world-no-tobacco-day-2019-awards. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
